name: Avatares AI - API - Promote Canonical Asset

parameters.query:
SELECT
  asset_id,
  avatar,
  asset_type,
  scene,
  bucket,
  object_path,
  mime_type,
  status,
  sha256,
  created_at,
  CONCAT(avatar, ':', scene, ':', asset_type) AS target_canonical_group
FROM canonical_asset_registry
WHERE asset_id = {{ $("Normalize Promote Request").first().json.assetIdSql }}
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
SET
  is_canonical = false,
  status = 'selected',
  metadata = jsonb_set(
    jsonb_set(
      COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
      '{status}',
      '"selected"'::jsonb,
      true
    ),
    '{isCanonical}',
    'false'::jsonb,
    true
  )
WHERE canonical_group = '{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.target_canonical_group }}'
  AND is_canonical = true
  AND asset_id <> '{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.asset_id }}';

UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
SET
  is_canonical = true,
  status = 'canonical',
  canonical_group = '{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.target_canonical_group }}',
  review_notes = {{ $("Normalize Promote Request").first().json.reviewNotesSql }},
  metadata = jsonb_set(
    jsonb_set(
      jsonb_set(
        jsonb_set(
          COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
          '{status}',
          '"canonical"'::jsonb,
          true
        ),
        '{isCanonical}',
        'true'::jsonb,
        true
      ),
      '{reviewNotes}',
      {{ $("Normalize Promote Request").first().json.reviewNotesJsonSql }}::jsonb,
      true
    ),
    '{canonicalGroup}',
    to_jsonb('{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.target_canonical_group }}'::text),
    true
  )
WHERE asset_id = '{{ $("Get Target Asset").first().json.asset_id }}'
RETURNING
  asset_id,
  avatar,
  asset_type,
  scene,
  bucket,
  object_path,
  mime_type,
  status,
  sha256,
  canonical_group,
  review_notes,
  created_at;

versionMetadata.name: Asset Review API v2
versionMetadata.description: Harden SQL handling for review notes and metadata updates.
